note: Every entry here is a high-severity npm advisory this platform has decided to carry, with the reason. The gate refuses a deploy when the high count exceeds high_allowed, so the number can only go down deliberately. Fixing an entry means removing it from this file and lowering high_allowed in the same commit.

accepted.advisory: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
accepted.reason: The fix is a major upgrade of a schema library used across the frontend. The advisory is a denial-of-service on attacker-supplied oversized collections, and every schema in this app validates responses from our own API, not arbitrary third-party payloads. Carried until the zod 4 migration is scheduled as its own item, because a half-tested major bump across 100 routed pages is a larger risk than the advisory.
